market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver's nominal all-time high is near $50 (1980, 2011), making a jump to $120 by mid-2026 an extraordinary >4x move from current ~$32 levels in under 18 months. Historical silver futures settlement data show such a spike has never occurred, and fundamental drivers (industrial demand, monetary policy) lack the capacity to produce a tripling in that timeframe. The market's 6.8% implied probability severely overestimates this tail risk.
evidence_points: CME Silver (SI) futures have never settled above $50 in their entire history, let alone $120.
Current silver spot price around $30–35 means a required rally of ~300% in ~1.5 years, a move not seen in any major commodity without a complete monetary collapse.
The resolution requires an active-month settlement at or above $120; mere intraday or indicative spikes do not count, reducing already remote chances.
